name: iqv-dictionary
description: IQV Dictionary — root convenience aliases: production Docker Compose stack commands, plus a local (Docker-less) `dev` script that runs backend + frontend hot-reload dev servers together (see scripts/common/dev.js). Application code lives in backend/ and dashboard/; install/update/uninstall lifecycle logic lives in scripts/windows and scripts/linux (this file intentionally does not duplicate that — see README.md "Directory Structure").
